literal_meaning: আকাশ থেকে আসা বাক্য বা স্বর
example_sentences_in_bangla: দেবতার আকাশবাণী শুনে সকলে বিস্মিত হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: The good news came like a voice from the sky.
Everyone was astonished hearing the divine proclamation from the heavens.
history: Originates from ancient Indian epics where gods communicate through voices from the sky, adapted in Bengali folklore.
note: Also the name of All India Radio's Bengali service, blending traditional idiom with modern broadcasting.
